task: Close the remaining WP0 admin-token writer gap on existing branch migration/svelte-admin-token-writer, created from PR #585 head 87b854ea1038e37fe7664bc607a965332a443d17. Read CLAUDE.md, apps/web/src/lib/auth/auth.ts and auth.test.ts, apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts and client.test.ts, apps/web/src/lib/persistence/{stores,storage,context}.ts and tests, OwnerAccessGate.svelte and its tests, and backend dual-mode owner/admin auth contracts. Implement a narrow session-only credential bridge so a successfully submitted owner-claim token becomes the same ed_admin_token consumed by the bounded API facade for subsequent admin/operator and observed-fact mutation requests. The token must be trimmed, written only after a successful owner claim, never placed in a URL, never written to localStorage, never included in profile sync, and never exposed in rendered copy or logs. A failed claim must leave the prior token state unchanged. Explicit sign-out must clear the session token; ordinary bootstrap/network failure must not silently destroy it. Preserve cookie-backed owner sessions and the existing endpoint allowlist: X-Admin-Token is present only on explicitly authorised admin/operator/owner-maintenance requests and observed-fact POST/PATCH/DELETE, absent on reads and all unrelated endpoints even when caller-supplied. Avoid circular imports and make the auth store testable by dependency injection rather than directly mocking global storage where practical. Add focused tests proving: successful trimmed claim persists the token and later bounded mutation carries the header; failed claim does not persist/replace it; sign-out clears it; sessionStorage rather than localStorage owns the value; applicationStores/profile-sync inventory does not leak it; absent token produces no header. Update OwnerAccessGate tests only where necessary to preserve password input clearing and error behaviour. Do not touch static preview/server work, routing, feature UI, React, Review Lab, production, deployment, database, OAuth configuration or Stage 27. Run apps/web check, lint, format check, unit tests, relevant Python persistence/auth contract tests, and git diff --check. Keep the diff small and leave this child branch ready for a PR into migration/svelte-platform-contracts after the independent static-preview repair lands.
